scripts.build: build_dir="dist-release-$$" && old_dir="dist-previous-$$" && vite build --outDir "$build_dir" && cp -r public/. "$build_dir/" && sleep 1 && test -s "$build_dir/index.html" && test -s "$build_dir/map/rome.dzi" && test -s "$build_dir/map/rome-painted.jpg" && test -s "$build_dir/data/rome-osm.json" && python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('public'); d=Path('$build_dir'); files=[p for p in s.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]; assert len(list((s/'map/rome_files').rglob('*.jpg'))) >= 200; assert all((d/p.relative_to(s)).is_file() and p.read_bytes() == (d/p.relative_to(s)).read_bytes() for p in files)" && if [ -d dist ]; then mv dist "$old_dir"; fi && mv "$build_dir" dist && (rm -rf "$old_dir" 2>/dev/null || true)
